scope: Proposition 6.1 (Integrated row moments) of the manuscript “The joint Dickman law for consecutive integers” (preprints/The-joint-Dickman-law-for-consecutive-integers-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 012 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e66b4e8a1fe197d3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a sufficiently fine fixed regularity grid and then a sufficiently small fixed tolerance, the independent-site latent kernel satisfies ∑ k̸=i E L2 ik ≪ B−.21 (1 ≤ i ≤ M). (6.1) Moreover, its normalized total mass has bounded second moment: E 1 M ∑ i,k Lik !2 ≪ 1. For every set I ⊆ {1, . . . , M}, the same estimates hold after replacing Lik by 1{i,k∈I}Lik; the normalization remains M.
